description: This file defines an abstract class 'SmtpEmailProviderBase' responsible for sending emails via SMTP, supporting online and offline modes, with SSL/TLS validation, proxy support, and email message construction.

classes.name: SmtpEmailProviderBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing SMTP email sending capabilities, including message creation, SSL validation, and support for different delivery methods.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an email message, handling different delivery methods and validation.

methods.name: GetMimeMessage
methods.description: Constructs a MimeMessage from a MailMessage, including recipients, subject, body, and attachments.

methods.name: SendOnlineMessageAsync
methods.description: Sends a MimeMessage via SMTP over the network with SSL/TLS and optional proxy.

methods.name: SendOfflineMessageAsync
methods.description: Saves the MimeMessage to a pickup directory for offline delivery.

methods.name: CertificateValidationCallback
methods.description: Validates the server's SSL certificate, logging errors and respecting configuration to ignore invalid certificates.
